quotes.text: I don’t care that they sold my idea but I care is that they don’t have any of their own.
quotes.author: Nikola Tesla

quotes.text: Intelligence is the ability to adapt to change.
quotes.author: Stephen Hawking

quotes.text: Before you’re diagnosed someone with depression, make sure they aren’t simply surrounded by idiots.
quotes.author: Sigmund Freud

quotes.text: Little knowledge makes people feel proud. A lot of knowledge makes people feel humble.
quotes.author: Leonardo da Vinci

quotes.text: No great discovery was ever made without a bold guess.
quotes.author: Isaac Newton

quotes.text: Truth will always remain true. Even if everyone rejects it and contradicts it.
quotes.author: Galileo Galilei

quotes.text: We cannot solve our problems with the same thinking we used when we created them.
quotes.author: Albert Einstein

quotes.text: A person who dares to waste one hour of their time has not discovered the value of life.
quotes.author: Charles Darwin

quotes.text: Sometimes people don't want to hear the truth because they don't want their illusions destroyed.
quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quotes.text: The further a society drifts from the truth, the more it will hate those who speak it.
quotes.author: George Orwell

quotes.text: It’s easier to fool people than to convince them that they have been fooled.
quotes.author: Mark Twain

quotes.text: All truth passes through three stages. First, it is ridiculed. Second, it is violently opposed. Third, it is accepted as being self-evident.
quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer

quotes.text: The more I learn, the more I realize how much I don't know.
quotes.author: Albert Einstein

quotes.text: The only true wisdom is in knowing you know nothing.
quotes.author: Socrates

quotes.text: The educated differ from the uneducated as much as the living from the dead.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.text: If you want to find the secrets of the universe, think in terms of energy, frequency and vibration.
quotes.author: Nikola Tesla

quotes.text: It is not that we have a short time to live, but that we waste a lot of it.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.text: Your time is limited, so don't waste it living someone else's life.
quotes.author: Steve Jobs

quotes.text: I am not what happened to me, I am what I choose to become.
quotes.author: Carl Jung

quotes.text: In the depth of winter, I finally learned that within me there lay an invincible summer.
quotes.author: Albert Camus

quotes.text: Everyone sees what you appear to be, few experience what you really are.
quotes.author: Machiavelli

quotes.text: Be alone, that is the secret of invention; be alone, that is when ideas are born.
quotes.author: Nikola Tesla

quotes.text: There are decades where nothing happens and there are weeks when decades happen.
quotes.author: Anonymous

quotes.text: Are we what we do with time or are we what time does with us?
quotes.author: Mahmud Darwish

quotes.text: The more you understand this world the more you destroy yourself. That’s why fools are happy and intelligent people live in loneliness.
quotes.author: Anonymous

quotes.text: And yet the only exciting life is the imaginary one.
quotes.author: Virginia Woolf

quotes.text: I am a victim of my own conscience. Constantly feeling guilty for things I have not done.
quotes.author: Franz Kafka

quotes.text: How many years does it take to forget a minute?
quotes.author: Anonymous

quotes.text: The war to end all wars, began
quotes.author: Unknown
